title: The Spine's Acoustic Fracture
logline: A station structural acoustic surveyor discovers that progressive micro-fractures in an overcrowded outer habitat ring were caused by unauthorized drilling from an executive luxury observation lounge built directly into the load-bearing spine.

roles.description: An uncompromising station structural analyst; underslept, meticulous, and terrified of catastrophic habitat decompression.
Real-estate developer who drilled a panoramic viewing lounge into the station's core keel to sell penthouses to corporate directors.
Loud advocate for the twelve thousand miner families living in the groaning outer dorm ring.
A light corporate security skiff enforcing local transit blockades around the residential perimeter.
A sleek corporate security gunboat armed with heavy pulse lasers and boarding clamps.
An isolated sensor mast mounted on the exterior hull measuring structural harmonic vibrations.
The cramped, noisy residential cylinder where working-class station personnel live under artificial gravity.
The private corporate board that leases habitat space and finances structural expansion.

public_situation: Residents in the outer dorm ring report terrifying metallic groaning sounds as station management dismisses the noise as harmless thermal expansion.
private_truth: {role:executive_developer} hollowed out three structural support ribs in the core spine to build an uncertified zero-g wine lounge, creating shearing stress that will tear the dorm ring loose.

beats.public_change: Tenants stage noise protests outside the municipal offices as structural groans reverberate through the ventilation ducts.

missions.reason: He hires an outside pilot to scan the exterior hull sensor pylon to record acoustic strain frequencies before the developer wipes the buffer.
missions.private_fact: His initial telemetry shows micro-fractures propagating at seven millimeters an hour through the main rotational hub.

beats.public_change: {role:executive_developer} posts armed security guards at the elevator shafts leading to the core spine, claiming private property rights.

missions.reason: He hires the pilot to deliver the decoded acoustic fracture logs to the tenant union hall before corporate enforcers seize his office.
missions.private_fact: The developer offered him a luxury penthouse and lifetime dividend shares if he alters his report to blame miner overcrowding.

beats.public_change: {role:developer_patrol_skiff} patrols the perimeter of the dorm ring, threatening to shoot down any shuttles broadcasting unauthorized telemetry.

missions.reason: She hires the pilot to destroy or disable the corporate security skiff so tenant leaders can broadcast an emergency evacuation warning.
missions.private_fact: She knows that if the truth airs, the entire station will face mass panic, but staying silent guarantees thousands die when the keel snaps.

beats.public_change: Deep metallic cracking sounds echo across the entire station as {role:developer_security_cutter} moves to jam external communications.

missions.reason: He hires the pilot to intercept the developer's armored security cutter and broadcast the raw structural findings to the judicial tribunal.
missions.private_fact: The developer hails offering an immense offshore bribe if the pilot breaks off the assault and escorts his private yacht into deep space.

player_choice.prompt: With the structural proof in hand and the station keel groaning toward collapse, the pilot must decide whether to expose the developer, take his fortune, or negotiate emergency repairs.

options.label: Broadcast the fracture telemetry openly to force immediate evacuation and arrest the developer
Accept the developer's bribe and escort his private yacht into deep space
Deliver the proof to the development board to force them to demolish the lounge and weld the keel

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot broadcasts the structural truth across the station.
resolutions.summary: Magistrates order {role:executive_developer} arrested. Ten thousand residents are safely evacuated from {role:dorm_habitat_ring} before the outer ring separates into vacuum.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot broadcast structural telemetry proving an executive luxury lounge had cracked the station's main keel.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot accepts the developer's bribe and helps him flee.
resolutions.summary: {role:executive_developer} escapes with his fortune. Hours later, the keel shears, hurling {role:dorm_habitat_ring} into space and killing thousands in catastrophic decompression.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot took blood money to escort a corrupt developer who drilled away the keel of a station habitat.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot forces the development board to repair the damage.
resolutions.summary: The luxury lounge is gutted and welded with reinforced steel girders. {role:executive_developer} is stripped of his assets to pay for structural reinforcement.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot brought evidence that forced a corporate board to tear out an executive lounge to brace a failing station keel.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot never intervenes or abandons the report.
resolutions.summary: The developer blames the groaning on tenant vibration. Marshals evict five hundred families from {role:dorm_habitat_ring} while the structural crack continues to widen.

loose_threads.detail: The core drilling permits carry municipal exemption stamps signed by a station housing commissioner who retired last month.
Structural reinforcement steel allocated for habitat maintenance was invoiced directly to an offshore luxury penthouse trust.

radio_hooks: Station maintenance department insists rotational hub acoustic groans are within safe tolerance.
Tenant union holds emergency rally protesting structural neglect in outer dorm ring.
Station development board unveils plans for new panoramic zero-gravity executive suites.

voice_direction.acoustic_surveyor: Rapid, breathless, and intensely focused on harmonic frequencies. Speaks like a man who knows the roof is about to collapse.
voice_direction.executive_developer: Arrogant, condescending, and dismisses physical engineering limits as bureaucratic speed bumps. Speaks with slick salesmanship.
voice_direction.habitat_tenant_organizer: Loud, furious, and speaks with fierce maternal protectiveness. Demands concrete safety answers and refuses corporate jargon.
